companyDescription: Space Launch + Defense AI · Alpha rocket small/medium-lift platform + Blue Ghost lunar lander — serving commercial, defense, and NASA customers with $1.3B backlog
priceNote: Strong Q1 record revenue $80.9M; $1.3B backlog + 80% of 2026 sales already booked — Jefferies raised PT to $52
summary: Firefly Aerospace has the strongest near-term visibility in the space sector: $1.3B backlog with 80% of 2026 revenue already contracted, Alpha rocket proven through Flight 7, and a dual defense + commercial flywheel. Blue Ghost Mission 2 (far-side Moon) is the next major price catalyst. Jefferies ($52) and KeyBanc ($50) are aligned on the thesis.

catalysts.name: Blue Ghost Mission 2 — Far Side Moon
catalysts.description: Second lunar mission will land on Moon's far side + deploy rover + operate 6 NASA payloads for 14 days. Validates Firefly as a repeat lunar delivery platform, unlocking further NASA CLPS task orders.

catalysts.name: Defense AI Contract — SciTec Air Force C2
catalysts.description: Firefly subsidiary SciTec won Air Force contract to deliver data fusion system for Cloud-Based Command & Control (CBC2) supporting NORAD, USNORTHCOM and PACAF — defense AI revenue diversification.

catalysts.name: Alpha Flight 8 — Block II Upgrade
catalysts.description: Alpha Flight 8 will be first full Block II configuration with new in-house avionics + enhanced thermal protection. Successful launch = capacity ramp to support booked 2026 manifest.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings — Revenue Ramp Read
catalysts.description: Q1 record $80.9M; full-year guidance $420–450M. Q2 earnings will validate ramp trajectory with 80% of sales already booked. Beat could drive re-rating toward analyst targets.

risks: Launch schedule slippage: any Alpha rocket anomaly delays revenue recognition and damages confidence

SpaceX competition intensifying — Falcon 9 taking market share in small/medium lift

Negative EPS (-$0.46 Q1) — not yet profitable; needs 2027+ to hit profitability
Blue Ghost Mission 2 is far-side Moon — technically more complex than Mission 1

catalystSpot.preRunup: Space launch + lunar mission stocks typically run 10-20% in 2-4 weeks before a mission launch as media coverage and retail interest build. LUNR ran +40% pre-IM-1 in early 2024. FLY with Blue Ghost Mission 2 announcement could see similar pre-launch excitement.

postWin.note: Rocket Lab (RKLB) successful launches drove +20-35% moves in 2023-2024 on combination of delivery confirmation + contract announcements. Blue Ghost Mission 1 (Mar 2025) validated FLY's lunar capability — Mission 2 success could drive similar 25-35% move.

postLose.note: Virgin Orbit (VORB) launch failure Feb 2023 drove -30% immediately; ultimately led to bankruptcy. FLY has stronger financial position but Alpha rocket anomaly would be -20-30%.

spotSizing.reason: High conviction: $1.3B backlog + 9 analyst Buy consensus + proven launch track record = 10% position appropriate. Not speculative — this is a revenue-generating aerospace company.

stopPreCatalyst.note: Below $22 = support break + sentiment shift — reassess thesis

stopPostCatalyst.note: If Alpha Flight 8 fails or Blue Ghost 2 anomaly — cut 50%, reassess
